title: Centre console controls and drive mode access
summary: Feedback on the centre console focuses on cumbersome drive mode and navigation interactions, occasional interface glitches, and concerns about button feel and interior materials.

positive.summary: One positive review notes that drive mode selection is available from the centre console, though the example is limited and includes criticism of the tap sequence.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe hard-to-use drive mode and console controls, sluggish or frozen console operation, awkward button design, and spill-prone console-adjacent cupholder use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention missing previous console controls, hard-to-distinguish buttons, cheap-feeling plastics or flex, multi-step mode-to-navigation switching, and one driving-mode reference without a clear console judgment.

limitations: Many examples are assigned undetermined sentiment, which limits clear interpretation of whether mentions of cheap materials, button layout, or missing controls are overall praise or criticism.
The cluster mixes several related but distinct subjects, including drive mode workflow, console hardware and materials, infotainment responsiveness, and a cupholder spill concern near the console.
Some fragments are too brief to support a precise aspect summary, such as the mention of the plastic tray under the centre console.
